what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1985?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports (calendar or as printed) and FY2011-FY2025 (fiscal). The 1985 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (172 pages) was searched for wage, gross, salary and payroll and found only the Treasurer's payroll DEDUCTION totals (p55, p58), the Auditor's payroll account in the bank list (p13, p54) and the lines `Special Detail Wages` (p56, p58) (sources/data/report-tables/1985/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1985 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1986?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1985 annual town report records only the article (p83: an article `by deleting the Classification and Salary Schedule voted on November 1, 1984 ... and substituting therefor the Classification and Salary Schedule proposed by the Personnel Committee and appearing in the report of the` Finance Committee) and not the schedule; searched for classification, salary schedule, step and grade (sources/data/report-tables/1985/). — closes: the Finance Committee's report to the May 11, 1985 Annual Town Meeting, which printed the Classification & Salary Schedule.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1985, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1985 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as lines of the general fund balance sheet (p59 `Due to Special Revenue Fund`, `Other Revolving Funds`), the Treasurer's receipts and payments lines for the school revolving accounts (p56, p58) and the School Department's own special accounts (p165-168); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched revolving and special revenue (sources/data/report-tables/1985/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1985 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1985?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1985 report prints no such schedule: its balance sheet carries `Appropriation for Capital Improvements` as a reserve line (p60) and the accountant's schedule lists each article (p72-77), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital project and capital fund (sources/data/report-tables/1985/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1985 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's FY1986 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs. The 1985 report prints no capital plan: the text mentions capital needs only in a Selectmen's passage on funding studies (p51: `to face up to many of its expected capital needs`) and one warrant article on reimbursement for capital projects (p88). Searched for capital (sources/data/report-tables/1985/). — closes: the Finance Committee's FY1986 report listing capital articles, or the capital needs study the Selectmen mention.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1986?
why: `report-valuation` holds the Assessors' tables (assessments by class, valuation and tax history, abstract by class code, overlay, new growth) from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011 onward. The 1985 report prints the FY'86 tax rate ($16.50 per thousand) and total valuation ($259,128,312) in prose (p15), the levy-limit components (allowable 2 1/2 increase, new growth, fire truck debt exemption, total $211,847) as an unlabelled four-line table (p52), and one reserve line (`Reserve Fund Overlay Surplus`, p61), but no table by class, no levy figure and no overlay figure. Searched for valuation, overlay, tax rate, new growth, levy and assessment (sources/data/report-tables/1985/). — closes: the Assessors' FY1986 tax rate recapitulation filed with the Department of Revenue.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1985, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 1985 report prints only the receipts line `Sealing Fees` in the statement of receipts (p56) and the Inspector of Weights & Measures in the lists of officials and in the budget (p84); no device counts and no fee schedule. Searched for weights, sealer and sealing (sources/data/report-tables/1985/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1985 annual report to the Division of Standards.

what: What did each line of the Treasurer's detailed statement of receipts and payments for fiscal 1985 amount to on the left-hand column of p56 and on p57?
why: Textract returned the left column of p56 (Town Clerk fees, the Treasurer's investment lines, protection permits, health, street betterments, articles) and the left panel of p57 (departmental payments, label and amount in one cell) in no table, so those lines are in `lines.tsv` only. Their section subtotals tie to the printed TOTAL RECEIPTS to the cent (NEEDS.md); the individual lines are not landed. — closes: a re-read of p56 and p57 that returns those panels as tables, or the Town Accountant's fiscal 1985 receipts and payments ledger.
